title: pteris minor
intro: Pteris minor, commonly known as the Chinese fern or dwarf bracken, is a type of perennial fern belonging to the genus Pteris. It is traditionally used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pteris minor are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. These bioactive constituents contribute to Pteris minor's ability to soothe digestive issues, calm coughs, and alleviate fever, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
